title: Final Judgment and Glory

questions.question: Thus says the LORD: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:1 (ESV): "and the earth is my footstool;"

questions.question: All these things my hand has made, and so all these things came to be, declares the LORD. But this is the one to whom I will look: he who is humble and contrite in spirit and trembles at my what?
He who kills an ox is like one who kills a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:3 (ESV): "He who kills an ox is like one who kills a man;"

questions.question: He who sacrifices a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:3 (ESV): "like one who breaks a dog's neck;"

questions.question: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: "Your brothers who hate you and cast you out for my name's sake have said, 'Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy'; but it is they who shall be what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:5 (ESV): "but it is they who shall be put to shame."

questions.question: Before she was in labor she gave birth; before her pain came upon her she delivered a what?
Who has heard such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be brought forth in a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:8 (ESV): "Shall a nation be brought forth in a moment?"

questions.question: Shall I bring to the point of birth and not cause to bring forth? says the LORD; shall I, who cause to bring forth, shut the what?
Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice with her in joy, all you who mourn over her; that you may nurse and be satisfied from her consoling what?
For thus says the LORD: "Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing what?"
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you shall be comforted in where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:13 (ESV): "you shall be comforted in Jerusalem."

questions.question: For behold, the LORD will come in fire, and his chariots like the whirlwind, to render his anger in fury, and his rebuke with flames of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:15 (ESV): "and his rebuke with flames of fire."

questions.question: For by fire will the LORD enter into judgment, and by his sword, with all flesh; and those slain by the LORD shall be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:16 (ESV): "and those slain by the LORD shall be many."

questions.question: And some of them I will take for priests and for Levites, says the LORD. For as the new heavens and the new earth that I make shall remain before me, says the LORD, so shall your offspring and your name what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:22 (ESV): "so shall your offspring and your name remain."

questions.question: 'From new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all flesh shall come to worship before me, declares the LORD. And they shall go out and look on the dead bodies of the men who have rebelled against me. For their worm shall not die, their fire shall not be quenched, and they shall be an abhorrence to all what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 66:24 (ESV): "and they shall be an abhorrence to all flesh."

key_verse_text: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
